b_01M0TKBW3VXA48AQTD8DCT8Y5K.content: The 'Sale' job type appears to be a buy-and-resell acquisition line (consistent with the 'Acquisitions' in the company name), distinct from the customer-paid restoration service captured at the project level, where TSA acquires a used spa, inspects it at the shop, and resells it.
b_01M0TKBW3VXA48AQTD8DCT8Y5K.falsification_test: If documentation shows Sale jobs involve no acquisition/possession of the spa (e.g., brokering or referral only), this belief would be wrong.
